messages:
From: Zephyr Billing <billing@zephyr.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Discrepancy on May invoice — overcharge at committed rate

Hi Marcus,

We reviewed the May invoice (attached) and noticed line items billed at the enterprise committed tier even though our contract (SOW #ZEP-6821) specifies a stepped usage rate that should have kicked in on May 2 (post-initial onboarding). The net difference on our side is EUR 12,450.

Can Redwood:
- Confirm whether the May runs were assigned to committed capacity or metered tiers;
- Issue a credit or refund for the overbilled portion; and
- Provide withholding documentation — our tax team needs a transaction-level record to claim VAT recredit and to satisfy our EU treasury.

We've attached the invoice and a CSV of the charge lines for convenience. We're trying to close Q2 by June 20, so an expedited resolution would be appreciated.

Thanks,
Sara Ortega
Billing Ops — Zephyr Analytics
Attachments: Zephyr_May2026_invoice_4579.pdf, zephyr-charge-lines-may.csv
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Zephyr Billing <billing@zephyr.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Discrepancy on May invoice — overcharge at committed rate

Sara —

Thanks for flagging this and for the CSV, that helps. Apologies for the disruption. I'm looping in Monica (finance) to reconcile and Karthik for contract/commit context. A few quick asks so we can triage:

- Can you share the transaction IDs (payment reference) or the HubSpot invoice id if present?
- Is the EUR 12,450 the total you expect as a net credit, or are there reserve/withholding amounts to consider on your side?

We will do an initial audit against our allocation logs and get back within 48 hours. If confirmed, we can either issue a credit note or process a refund to the original payment method — let us know your preference.

Marcus Lin
Head of Partnerships — Redwood Inference

Hi Sara,

I've started a ledger trace and provisioned a credit note (attached) for the suspected overbilled amount pending final reconciliation. A few items we need from your side to complete the accounting:

1) Confirmation of the exact bank transaction reference (ideally the payment UUID we can match to our remittance file).
2) Your VAT registration certificate for the billing entity (so we can mark the credit as non-taxable where applicable).
3) Whether Zephyr will accept a credit on account (reduces next invoice) or requires a cash refund to the original account.

If you need a formal vendor-withholdings statement for EU tax reclaim, we can produce a transactional remittance extract but will need the above to avoid double-taxing. Attaching provisional-credit-note-4579.pdf for your review — this will be updated once matching is complete.

Best,
Monica Patel
Revenue Operations — Redwood Inference

Monica —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Per your list:

1) Payment/reference: ZEP-PMT-20260530-9F1D
2) VAT cert: attached (zephyr-vat-certificate.pdf) — Zephyr Holdings B.V.
3) Preference: our treasury prefers a refund (wired back to the same account) but will accept a credit on account if refund timing exceeds 30 days.

For the withholding statement: our local tax counsel requires the remittance ID and a short note confirming Redwood did not apply additional platform-level VAT on the credit (so we can claim reverse-charge where applicable). We can sign a simple attestation — sending a DocuSign form now (link below).

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/ZX9F3Q-reclaim-form

Can you confirm whether Redwood can wire EUR 12,450 back to the payment reference above and provide the remittance extract for our records?

Sara

Sara —

All good — appreciate the docs. Internal update and next steps: 

- Monica confirmed the ledger match; we will issue a refund of EUR 12,450 to ZEP-PMT-20260530-9F1D. Treasury/finance will initiate the wire tomorrow (ETA 3–5 business days).
- Monica/Aditya will attach the remittance extract to this thread once the wire is initiated (file: redwood-remittance-ack-4579.csv).
- We will mark the credit note as non-taxable for EU reporting and include the VAT certificate in the vendor file to support your reverse-charge claim.
- Karthik: please note for renewal discussions — we've flagged the allocation bug (root cause: commit assignment pasture during pod migration) and will provide a short postmortem to Zephyr.

Sara, if a refund timing issue arises and you need a short-term credit instead, please let us know and we'll convert the refund to a credit immediately. Otherwise expect the remittance confirmation by end of tomorrow.

Thanks again for the clear reconciliation — sorry for the noise, and we'll follow up with the postmortem and the remittance artifact.

Cheers,
Marcus Lin
Head of Partnerships — Redwood Inference
